renderer: GitHub REST Markdown API, POST /markdown with mode=gfm
method: Render every complete unmodified supplemental response; independently decode the returned HTML and compare literal fenced output and complete original/revised quotations inside bold. Retain all HTML and checks for separate review.
limitations: GFM renderer evidence only, not installed-host activation, clipboard behavior, wrap controls, or actual Instant acceptance.
